name: Japan
description: Japan is a parliamentary constitutional monarchy and one of the world's largest economies. Postwar industrial policy produced global leaders in automotive, electronics and robotics, organized around keiretsu networks and coordinated business-government councils. It now navigates rapid demographic aging, high public debt and energy import dependence while leading in automation and materials science.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of Japan's actor space from Meiji-era zaibatsu and MITI-guided industrialization through post-bubble restructuring to keiretsu successor groups, trading houses, and robotics-led manufacturers.

works.title: Keiretsu and Supply-Chain Network
works.description: Network analysis of cross-shareholdings, tiered suppliers, and trading-company intermediation linking assembly hubs to Asian production networks.

works.title: Prefectural and Metropolitan Structure
works.description: Geospatial representation of forty-seven prefectures, the Tokyo Bay megaregion's demographic weight, and Shinkansen-integrated industrial corridors.
